name: Redesigned legacy console read-only smoke
preconditions: Lead-owned disposable save only, new console command DLL installed and restarted, guard ON. Capture and inspect native console output: map unique playable types/tier order, nearby instance bounds/page/filter, memory-ranked resident textures/streaming columns and exact loaded bundle inventory. Script success alone does not prove output semantics, remote permissions or native source attribution. No spawns, resets, unloads or inventory changes.
